claims.head: Philadelphia’s chances off turnovers meet a soft spot
claims.body: Philadelphia ranks 7th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.7% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Detroit ranks 27th of 32 for avoiding breakdowns.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 3 games this season

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Opposite ends on forecheck pressure
claims.body: Detroit ranks 9th of 32 for forecheck pressure, toward the hounding end; Philadelphia ranks 28th, toward the passive end.
